# LLAAPP Vancouver BC | App Development & Enterprise Engineering

## Summary
LLAAPP is an app development and enterprise engineering partner specializing in modern software engineering, distributed systems, and technical governance. We provide senior-level consulting and high-performance engineering squads to help Vancouver, BC organizations and global teams design, build, modernize, and automate business applications.

- **Transformation Strategy**: Digital operating models, legacy modernization roadmaps, and architectural governance.

- **Agile Senior Squads**: Elite technical teams (senior developers, architects, and QA) integrated into client CI/CD pipelines.
- **Cloud & Platform**: SRE, DevOps automation, and multi-cloud infrastructure orchestration (AWS, GCP, Azure).
- **Business Automation Apps**: Workflow automation for approvals, operations, reporting, and internal productivity.
- **Insight & Growth**: Advanced data analytics, performance reporting, and data-driven digital acquisition.
